description: History, movements, techniques, and key figures in the visual arts

art_elements.line: Direction, weight, texture, and implied movement

color.complementary: Opposite colors on wheel; maximum contrast

art_elements.space: Positive and negative areas; perspective creates depth
art_elements.value: Lightness or darkness of a color

art_movements.neoclassicism: Late 1700s; return to classical Greek/Roman ideals

impressionism.characteristics: Capture fleeting moments, visible brushstrokes, light and atmosphere

key_artists.van_gogh: Expressive brushwork, vivid color; The Starry Night

surrealism.characteristics: Dreams and the unconscious; irrational imagery

abstract_expressionism.characteristics: Large canvases, gestural abstraction, emotional intensity

pop_art.characteristics: Mass culture imagery, bold colors, commercial aesthetics

art_movements.contemporary: Post-1970s; diverse media including installation, video, performance, digital art

painting.oil: Slow-drying; rich colors; blendable; dominant since 15th century
painting.tempera: Egg-based; precise; used before oil painting

major_museums.louvre: Paris; largest museum; Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo
major_museums.metropolitan: New York; 2+ million objects spanning 5,000 years
